why: Options 1, 3, 4 and 5 are one shape (a block with a zigzag edge) turned to different angles. Option 2 is the flipped (mirror) version: going round its outline, the long straight edge and the zigzag come in the opposite order.
trick: Turn the shapes in your head; the one that only matches after flipping is the odd one.
